sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 3XL.
Increases physical and magic attack Ability success value by M.
Ability Power scales with the number of Dual Blade type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 4XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Dual Blade type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
